race.comment: MASMELO (2) was just fair on the quick turnaround last start when remaining at the mile, finishing soundly in tougher company. That form has already been franked and she drops back to an easier race this time around. Looks better suited to this event today and she can return to winning form. PINCER MOVEMENT (14) is a progressive talent, winning first-up at Bunbury when sitting handy over 1685m at Bunbury. CJP now rides, but he's got plenty of upside and he'll take some catching with no weight on his back. RUTHLESS ANGEL (11) continues to knock on the door, beaten just 0.7L last start after settling back in the Champion Fillies. Taking on the older horses now, but she's already shown she's up to this level and the rise in trip can see her go one better. VEXATIOUS ROSE (12) can go one better without surprising, with her last start form being franked. SPANK APPEAL (6) can be up front from the outset and give a bold sight.
